name: HITRUST CSF + AI Security Assessment and Certification (AI Security for Deployed AI Systems)
description: HITRUST CSF v11.8.0 (current as of mid-2026) is a prescriptive, certifiable security/privacy control framework; its AI Security Assessment and Certification (introduced v11.4.0, available as ai1 paired with e1/i1 or ai2 paired with r2) adds up to 44 curated AI-specific requirement statements across 12 topic categories, harmonized to NIST, ISO, OWASP LLM Top 10 2025, and MITRE ATLAS mitigations, and requires the in-scope AI system to be in production deployment. AKSI maps strongly to the runtime-facing categories (access, logging/monitoring, filtering/sanitizing inputs-outputs, model robustness
jurisdiction: United States / Global (private-sector certification regime; healthcare-origin, sector-agnostic). HITRUST Alliance.
regime_version: HITRUST CSF v11.8.0 (effective May 7-8, 2026); AI Security Assessment introduced v11.4.0 (Dec 2024), refreshed through v11.8.0 with OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 + MITRE ATLAS mitigation mappings
